name: Asymptotic Weight Trap
description: Replaces a lexicographical tie-breaking rule with a mathematically equivalent exponentially weighted sum. Models that pattern-match will perceive it as a general NP-hard optimization problem or will naively compute the massive integers and TLE. Models that reason structurally will realize the sum is just a base-3 representation, making it equivalent to lexicographical order, which can be solved greedily per component in linear time.
